To confirm the season of Lisa's conversion to Buddhism, I cross-referenced the episodes that mention her conversion. The episode "She of Little Faith" from Season 13 explicitly details Lisa's conversion to Buddhism. The subsequent episode "Tis the Fifteenth Season" from Season 15 only references her Buddhism since the earlier episode, confirming that the conversion occurred in Season 13.

FINDING: Lisa converts to Buddhism in Season 13 of "The Simpsons".
